market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver would need to rise ~4x from current ~$30 to $120 in ~18 months, far exceeding its all-time high of $50. Such a move in this timeframe has virtually no historical precedent, making the market's 6.8% implied probability a significant overestimate.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time high is ~$50 (1980, 2011), less than half the target.
A 4x rally in 18 months would require extraordinary and sustained catalysts not currently visible.
Futures market fundamentals and speculative positioning do not support a super-spike of this magnitude.
